name: ATLAS-300
description: "Trustworthy artificial intelligence requires methods capable of assessing how risk propagates across interconnected data and AI lifecycle components rather than evaluating individual components independently. This dataset provides a reproducible benchmark for evaluating such dependency-aware assurance methods. ATLAS-300 comprises 300 directed weighted graph instances with 48 nodes per graph, producing 14,400 node-level records. Node attributes include intrinsic risk, severity, evidence confidence, graph connectivity, independent-reference risk scores, and reference rankings. Ground-truth reference rankings are generated by a separately specified nonlinear computational oracle rather than by the evaluated ATLAS formulation, reducing circularity in computational validation. Predictions from intrinsic-risk, one-hop, PageRank-style, ATLAS, confidence-ablation, and propagation-ablation configurations are provided. Evaluation outputs include Recall@10, Precision@10, NDCG@10, and Kendall\u2019s tau for 1,800 method-replicate combinations. Complete graph edges, predictions, reference labels, metadata, data dictionary, aggregate statistics, and reproducibility code are included. The benchmark supports research in trustworthy AI, lifecycle assurance, AI governance, graph-based risk propagation, ranking, ablation analysis, and reproducible computational evaluation."
